title: Girl doing homework in a library
notes: Static wide shot: college-age female student with white earphones at a black laptop in a dim library (dark wooden shelves full of books behind), typing with one hand at her ear; notebook and book stack on the desk. Medium-dim, warm-neutral, not BRIGHT. Her face is clearly visible (front) - reads as a generic participant ('여러분'), not as the protagonist. No logo on the laptop lid, book spines not readable: no blur needed. Literal for 'college students took part in an online study' (student + laptop + library). One continuous take to 23.1 s (she writes notes / rests head on hand later, ~7-22 s). Alt 1827 (Free): hands typing on a laptop in a dim room, no face, but a dark Apple logo on the lid would need a blur.

title: Designer in his studio giving color to his strokes in a notebook
notes: High angle over a man's shoulder (dark hair, glasses, beard, black shirt; face mostly hidden by his head) colouring a simple orange triangle in a spiral sketchbook with a marker; green cutting mat, ruler, pens around. Medium brightness (white paper/table) with dark clothing, indoor, not daylight. Small print on the marker barrel and ruler ticks is not readable once the centre-subtitle blur is on, so no blur box. Reads as 'the drawing scene'; same shoot as alt 29984 (continuity). No cut in the 14.1 s take.

title: Sad and crestfallen man sitting in the dark
notes: Dark silhouette of a seated man in profile (dreadlocks outline, no visible face) against a soft green window. 4.0-7 he sits still, ~7.5-11 hand on his head (struggle), ~12-12.6 lowers the hand and looks up - fits 'take the difficulty as proof of no interest' -> 'but at the same moment you could ask'. Overall dark and cinematic (background greenery is soft daylight). No text. All-centre segment, so only the mood counts; the silhouette avoids a different face standing in for the protagonist. One take to 15.2 s. Alt 29982 (Free): the st11 designer drawing at his desk, side view, calm rather than frustrated. 100112 (Free, man thinking in a dark room) is only 8.5 s, 0.1 s short of need_sec.

title: A ceramic artist modeling pottery
notes: Top-down close-up of clay-covered hands centring clay on a spinning pottery wheel; forearms only, no face. Grey and muted, medium brightness (a bright window corner at top-left; darken a little). No text. Clear 'another hobby/activity' visual for '다른 활동을 골라도 됩니다'. One take to 13.0 s. Alt 42822 (Free): dim close-up of hands strumming a ukulele.

title: Drawing a heart on a foggy window on a rainy day
notes: Silhouetted hand drawing a simple heart with a finger on a misted, rain-speckled window. Cool grey and backlit: the window is fairly bright but rainy/moody, not cheerful (darken a little). At 8.0 the right half is already drawn and the finger completes the left half; the whole heart reads from ~11 s to 13.4 s. No face, no text. Literal 'an easier, simpler drawing' (the heart also echoes '그리고 싶은 마음'). After ~15.5 s the camera drifts onto dark leaves (no hard cut), so stay before 15.5 s. Alt 29984 (Free, downloaded as spare, full/29984.mp4): hands drawing a simple paper-plane shape with markers, use 5.0-10.4 s, but the camera slides and brand/barcode print on the pencils, pen and marker is readable, so it would need moving blurs.

title: Lilies flowers on its stem slowly opening
notes: Time-lapse of yellow lily buds opening into full blooms; the right-hand bud opens from ~3 s to ~6.8 s. BRIGHT, saturated chroma-blue studio background: desaturate/darken (it sits under centre subtitles, so it is blurred anyway). No text, no people. Literal 'fun not yet experienced inside a small interest'. One take to 17.2 s (both lilies fully open later). Alt 4483 (Free): ranunculus flowers slowly opening on a dark background, but the hue cycles through colours (fine if fully desaturated). The black-background bloom and sprout clips (34515, 34627, 34700, 14882, 47540) are all Restricted.

title: Shot of the hands of a talented pianist playing
notes: Side close-up of a man's hands (leather cuff, rings) playing a polished wooden piano in a dim, warm room; hands only, no face, static camera. Dim warm brown. The piano brand 'ROSENTHAL' is printed on the fallboard in the same place for the whole take -> blur_box (it is also unreadable under the centre blur). Repeated playing reads as practice for '연습만 계속하면 되는 걸까요?'. One take to 24.1 s. Alt 44140 (Free): hands on a keyboard in warm dim light, 17.8 s.

title: Movie tape
notes: Close-up of a metal film reel turning in the dark, cyan-tinted, with light flicker and slight camera drift (one take; scene-detector hits in the first 6 s are only the rotating holes/flicker, hence in 6.5). Dark. No text; the hub is a plain reel clip, not a logo. Old-film look = 'an old experiment (1973)'. Can be desaturated to grey/sepia. Clean to 12.1 s. Alt 100887 (Free): hands typing on a green retro typewriter, warm and dim, but its brand name is readable on the body (needs a blur). The vintage projector clips 28421, 28422, 38817 are Restricted.
